To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PEV participation in the energy and reactive power markets can be beneficial for the system.
the coupled energy and reactive market can improve the network condition and reduce the cost of reactive power provision.
PEV can participate in both energy market and reactive market without battery degradation and the proposed model can be used for both energy and reactive power markets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the integration of PEVs into microgrids as energy and reactive power providers.
the integration of PEVs in microgrids as energy and reactive power providers in market environment.
the integration of PEVs in the microgrid, as both energy and reactive power providers in the market environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the participation of PEVs in the energy and reactive power markets can be beneficial to both distribution companies (DISCOs) and PEV owners.

the proposed reactive power market is a good alternative to the conventional energy market to improve the network conditions, and the proposed coupled energy market and reactive market is a good solution for the microgrid operation in the presence of high penetration of PEVs, which is capable of providing both active and reactive power.
the proposed coupled energy/reactive power market is more efficient and profitable than the energy market only.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed market mechanism can be applied for the microgrids with or without PEV participation, and it can be extended to include more resources and more market types such as ancillary services market.
PEVs can be effectively integrated into the microgrids as energy and reactive power providers.
the coupled energy and reactive market can be a good alternative for the current electricity market in which the reactive power is not paid much attention.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PEVs can be effectively integrated into a market environment to provide energy and reactive power.
the PEVs can participate in both energy and reactive power markets without battery degradation and improve the overall market efficiency.
the PEVs can be used to provide reactive power to the network in a market environment, which is a new contribution to the literature.
